mnemonic: The Duchess Heads out the Back door. DH-H-B is the root of going and departing.
example: She ذهب to work early, يذهب there every morning as the ذاهب one.

mnemonic: A Jester Arrives, Announcing his entrance loudly. J-ʾ-ʾ is the root of coming and arriving.
example: He جاء late, but his مجيء was still celebrated.

mnemonic: A Detective Kicks the Lock to enter the room. D-KH-L is the root of entering and inside.
example: He دخل through the مدخل and stood داخل the hall.

mnemonic: A Knight Rushes out the Gate. KH-R-J is the root of exiting and going out.
example: She خرج quickly through the مخرج to stand خارج the building.

mnemonic: A Wanderer Steps in at Last. W-Ṣ-L is the root of arriving and connecting.
example: The train وصل on time, and its وصول meant the line stayed متصل.

mnemonic: A Runner Jogs back Again. R-J-ʿ is the root of returning and going back.
example: He رجع home at sunset, his رجوع expected every day.

mnemonic: A Queen Wakes and stands Majestic. Q-W-M is the root of standing, rising, and getting up.
example: He قام from his chair, and every morning يقوم the same way.

mnemonic: A Juggler Lands and Sits down abruptly. J-L-S is the root of sitting.
example: He جلس on the bench, and the council's مجلس also means a sitting place.

mnemonic: A Farmer Turns the Handle to open the gate. F-T-Ḥ is the root of opening.
example: He فتح the door with a مفتاح, leaving it مفتوح.

mnemonic: A Ghost Locks the Quarters shut. GH-L-Q is the root of closing.
example: He غلق the shop early, so it stayed مغلق all night.

mnemonic: A Hiker's Mule Lugs the heavy bags. Ḥ-M-L is the root of carrying and bearing.
example: The mule حمل the load, and every day it يحمل more as a حامل.

mnemonic: A Traveler Runs off, Kaput — gone for good. T-R-K is the root of leaving and abandoning.
example: He ترك the old house, and it stayed متروك for years.

mnemonic: A Waiter Drops off the Order at your table. W-Ḍ-ʿ is the root of placing and putting.
example: She وضع the plate down, and the موضوع of the meeting was already set.

mnemonic: A Watchman Quietly Freezes in place. W-Q-F is the root of stopping and standing still.
example: The bus وقف at the موقف, and everyone يقف waiting.

mnemonic: A Marcher Shuffles onward, Yawning as he walks. M-SH-Y is the root of walking.
example: He مشى to the park, since يمشي there is his daily مشي.
